title: Source-derived Lake Keowee parcel criteria for the retained Upper Savannah study
method_reference: Lake Keowee Watershed-based Plan (2020), Tables 31/34/36/37/39/40/41/42; Appendix D, printed pages 138-147.

source_facts.fact: NHD Flowline fields include ftype, reachcode, lengthkm and permanent_identifier; this layer does not supply the HR stream-order field.
Network NHDFlowline exposes streamorde (StreamOrder), NHDPlusID and permanent_identifier.
Official USGS NHDPlus HR user guidance for the original network attributes.
Current NWI fields are ATTRIBUTE and WETLAND_TYPE. Source editions may expose qualified field names; the actual original field selection is retained.
Original wetland special modifiers b,d,f,h,m,r,s,x identify beaver, partial drainage/ditching, farming, diking/impoundment, management, artificial substrate, spoil and excavation.
NLCD classes 81/82 denote pasture/hay and cultivated crops; 41/42/43 are forests; 21/22/23/24 denote developed classes.
Annual NLCD legend retains the selected original class meaning.

Active classified-reach source uses original H2OCLASS and native OBJECTID. Its separately retained target-class capture has 1,886 native features; the original exact217-HUC ID query returns those same IDs and the original HUC8 04-07 target-class count is zero.
Internal original data carrier contains classified geometry and original full217 query/scope responses, FY2026 NRCS source tables, water-supply inventories and dated attainment/listing sources.

metric_conventions.parcel_acres: Full original parcel polygon area / 4046.8564224; reporting parcel acres remain separate.
metric_conventions.context_geometry: Original water, wetland, hydric, sensitive-riparian, floodplain, impairment, point and CWA criteria use settings.spatial_criteria_basis. New default whole_original_parcel preserves parcel-based source definitions; reporting_parcel is an explicit retained boundary adaptation.
metric_conventions.agricultural_cover: At least half the full original parcel under default land_cover_basis; explicit reporting_parcel adaptation is recorded.
metric_conventions.protected_status: Default already_protected requires full original parcel coverage by the selected protected-land inventory. Raw observed fraction remains available; protected_fraction_threshold records an explicit alternative.
metric_conventions.adjacency: Default exact original geometry contact (0 metres); positive adjacency_m is recorded as an explicit distance adaptation.
metric_conventions.stream_length: Unioned original ftype 460 line length inside the selected spatial_criteria_basis. Study threshold is the arithmetic mean among positive complete lengths; all selected parcels must have source coverage under that same basis.
metric_conventions.headwater: Default original positive integer streamorde in [1,2]; raw complete stream_orders and observed values are retained for the [1] protection variant.
metric_conventions.floodplain: Presence of the selected one-percent footprint plus development status; without_development means no selected developed class is present, with complete land-cover support.
metric_conventions.sensitive_riparian: Original full union or original variable buffer unioned with the 30.48-metre surface-water buffer. Every mapped component is a positive subset of that union; a missing component expands the retained acreage interval. A constant buffer alone retains its named observed quantity and contributes a lower limit to the union.
metric_conventions.water_classification: Exact mapped original class values; target-only capture does not establish FW absence. All-class/FW and active high-quality source editions remain separate.
metric_conventions.impairment: Explicit selected edition/pollutant scope and spatial/upstream contribution relation. An upstream contribution layer must come from the existing receiving-water workflow.
metric_conventions.raster: Original projected metre-based north-up pixels, no resampling, exact cell/polygon overlap areas; native study binds its exact original grid NLCD source.
metric_conventions.empty: False or exact area zero uses actual certainty coverage. For numeric acreage, original parcel geometry also supplies an upper limit; published threshold points can be determined even when exact acreage remains null.
metric_conventions.unknown: Null records a criterion that the selected original inputs do not yet determine; original IDs, observed quantities and matched field values remain available.
metric_conventions.current_export: Current model export classes are supplied by the existing native score binding; the source-only builder never replaces them with geographic proxies.
metric_conventions.numeric_intervals: Closed acreage limits retain positive geometry and unresolved source coverage inside the declared spatial_criteria_basis. Whole original parcel size remains independent. Exact acreage stays null until determined; equal published threshold contributions can still determine exact points.

numeric_intervals.lower: Area of original positively selected footprint intersecting the selected parcel geometry.
numeric_intervals.upper: Lower area plus parcel area outside the union of positive footprint and actual certainty coverage.
numeric_intervals.exact_value: Canonical numeric value is retained only when known exactly; row.metric_bounds retains source-limited endpoints otherwise.
numeric_intervals.hydric: Default fully hydric/nonhydric certainty excludes mixed and unknown map units; component percentages are retained original attributes and are never allocated to an unobserved part of a parcel.
numeric_intervals.riparian: A positively mapped component belongs to the original variable-plus-constant union. Composite absence uses complete component support; partial composite upper limits remain conservative.
numeric_intervals.threshold_application: Evaluate the original published piecewise step function on all attainable interval values. Equal point limits determine exact criterion points.
exports: criteria.csv numeric *_lower and *_upper columns plus metric_bounds JSON
criteria.gpkg original_parcels and reporting_parcels numeric lower/upper columns plus metric_bounds

source_references.meaning: Published riparian, hydric and full-parcel acreage thresholds.
Original hydclprs, component hydricrating, native MUKEY and soil polygon fields.

spatial_criteria_geometry.reference: Lake Keowee Watershed Plan (2020), Appendix D: printed139 describes riparian acreage within each parcel; printed140 describes parcel acreage containing hydric soil; printed142 describes the full parcel size criterion.
spatial_criteria_geometry.interpretation: Whole original parcel is the default implementation of the parcel-based criteria. An explicit reporting intersection is retained as an adaptation, with its full original parcel and reporting area still exported separately.
spatial_criteria_geometry.legacy: Completed prior tables retain their original interval area_basis and table settings. New preparation creates a new implementation/source identity; an old table is never relabelled.
spatial_criteria_geometry.source_coverage: Query masks and source certainty must cover the actually selected geometry. Missing coverage outside the reporting boundary remains unresolved; exact positive observations and closed acreage bounds are preserved.
spatial_criteria_geometry.halo: Waterway-buffer derivation queries original waterways within the selected parcel buffered by the retained waterway_buffer_m; adjacency uses the retained adjacency_m.
